items.stem: Why do GPUs and TPUs outperform general-purpose CPUs on deep-learning matrix operations?

options.text: They provide massive data parallelism and dedicated matrix units suited to these regular operations
options.rationale: Correct: accelerators exploit the regular, highly parallel structure of matrix math.

options.text: They run at far higher clock frequencies than any CPU
options.rationale: Accelerators often clock lower; their advantage is parallelism, not clock speed.

options.text: They execute Python source code directly in hardware
options.rationale: They do not execute Python directly; kernels are compiled.
Memory bandwidth is central; they do not avoid memory.

items.explanation: Correct: accelerators exploit the regular, highly parallel structure of matrix math.

items.stem: Which TWO factors most strongly limit throughput for a memory-bound AI kernel? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Available memory bandwidth to feed the compute units
options.rationale: Correct: a memory-bound kernel is limited by how fast data can be delivered.

options.text: The amount of data movement between memory and the chip
options.rationale: Correct: excess data movement starves the compute units.

options.text: The number of comment lines in the source code
options.rationale: Source comments have no effect on runtime throughput.

options.text: The colour of the accelerator's heatsink
options.rationale: Physical appearance is irrelevant to throughput.

items.explanation: Correct: a memory-bound kernel is limited by how fast data can be delivered.

items.stem: Using the roofline model, a kernel sits to the left of the ridge point. What does this indicate?

options.text: It is memory-bound, so improving data reuse or bandwidth helps most
options.rationale: Correct: left of the ridge point means performance is bounded by memory bandwidth.

options.text: It is compute-bound and needs more arithmetic units
options.rationale: Compute-bound kernels sit to the right of the ridge point.

options.text: It has reached the theoretical peak performance
options.rationale: Sitting left of the ridge means it is below peak, bounded by bandwidth.

options.text: Precision format is the only possible bottleneck
options.rationale: The roofline position points to bandwidth, not solely precision.

items.explanation: Correct: left of the ridge point means performance is bounded by memory bandwidth.
